# Use all 30 samples for pre-filtering
count_cols_30 = [sample_id_to_col[sid] for sid in all_30_samples]
counts_all_30 = counts_df[count_cols_30]
print(f"Counts for 30 samples shape: {counts_all_30.shape}")

# Filter: keep genes with counts > 10 in at least one sample
keep = (counts_all_30 > 10).any(axis=1)

# ============================================================

print(subset_layout[['SampleID', 'Group']].to_string())

counts_subset = counts_filtered[subset_cols]

metadata.index = counts_subset_t.index  # Use sample IDs as index
metadata = metadata.rename(columns={'Group': 'condition'})

print(f"\nMetadata:\n{metadata}")

print("\nRunning pydeseq2 DESeqDataSet...")

)
